name: project-workspace
title: Project Workspace
description: Scan local codebases, monitor dev servers, manage offline issues, and turn brainstorms into action
author: DavidWilde

commands.name: list-projects
commands.title: List Projects
commands.subtitle: Workspace Catalog
commands.description: Scan codebases, enrich project metadata, pin favorites, and open projects in your tools

preferences.name: initialScanRoot
preferences.title: Initial Scan Root
preferences.description: Required before the command opens. Choose the first directory to scan. You can add more scan roots later from the command actions.

preferences.name: additionalScanRoots
preferences.title: Additional Scan Roots
preferences.description: Optional. Enter more absolute paths separated by new lines or commas if you want to seed multiple roots during first setup.

preferences.name: defaultIdeApp
preferences.title: Default IDE
preferences.description: Required. Choose the IDE used by Quick Open when a project does not define its own IDE override.

preferences.name: defaultTerminalApp
preferences.title: Default Terminal
preferences.description: Required. Choose the terminal used by Quick Open when a project does not define its own terminal override.

commands.name: running-projects
commands.title: Running Projects
commands.subtitle: Dev Server Monitor
commands.description: Show active dev servers for saved projects with monorepo-aware names, ports, and paths

commands.name: list-issues
commands.title: List Issues
commands.subtitle: Offline Planning
commands.description: Track local project work with statuses, priorities, labels, and completion dates

commands.name: list-brainstorms
commands.title: List Brainstorms
commands.subtitle: Idea Capture
commands.description: Capture Markdown brainstorms per project and turn them into issues with Raycast AI

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
